label: thm:lpf_correct
title: Correctness of the least-prime-factor table
statement: After the sieve terminates, the output table $\mathrm{lp}$ is a least-prime-factor table up to $n$.
proof: By induction on the outer index $i$ from $2$ to $n+1$, using \ref{lem:outer_invariant_step} at each step. The invariant at $n+1$ implies every entry in $\mathrm{lp}$ is correct.
